description: This file defines several macros for use within CMake build scripts, including macros to add libraries with specific link properties, generate Lemon parser sources, and set target properties.

methods.name: ADD_AND_INSTALL_LIBRARY
methods.description: Defines a macro to create and install a static or shared library based on build options and platform specifics.

methods.name: LEMON_PARSER
methods.description: Defines a macro to generate Lemon parser source and header files from a specified source file.

methods.name: ADD_TARGET_PROPERTIES
methods.description: Defines a macro to append properties to a specified target in CMake.
